## Why

Raised by the reviewer in round 1 of ork run ork-20261122-081958-ba4a for S401 (discovered from S401):

Make pgup the exact inverse of pgdown in help
pgup steps by the current window's visible count (`model.go:845-846`). From offset 0, pgdown moves to 18 at 80x24. pgup from 18 steps back 17 (both markers are shown) and lands on offset 1, so the top takes two presses. This meets the spec, but the human check asks for smooth paging.

## Failing tests

- `TestHelpPageUpInvertsPageDown`: one pgup after one pgdown returns helpOffset to 0 (80x24, 80x16, 60x16, 100x24).
- `TestHelpNarrowHintKeepsScrollDropsQuit`: at 60x16 the help hint has `pgup/pgdown` and `close help` and no `q quit`; at 50x14 it has `pgup/pgdown` and no `q quit`.
- `TestHelpNarrowHintNeverQuitWithoutScroll`: at every width 30-79 (16 rows) the help hint never shows `q quit` without `pgup/pgdown`.
- `TestHelpMouseWheelScrollsOneLine`: with showHelp true, a wheel-down message moves helpOffset by 1 with mouse on, a wheel-up by -1, and neither moves it with mouse off.
